long:
LiDAR Exploration Program is an atmospheric adventure game with light horror elements, where you can't see the world around you. Use the lidar scanner to colorize everything around you. The game contains several levels to explore, in each of which you have to scan unknown objects.

EXPLORE AND SCAN
You find yourself in complete darkness, in which you can't see anything, but thanks to the scanner you can find your way.
SCAN UNKNOWN OBJECTS
You will have to look for objects, some of them will be ordinary, and some will seem very strange and creepy. Using the scanner you will be able to explore them.
USE MAP
You can use a map that shows the environment from above. With its help you can find the very objects that need to be scanned.
8 LEVELS AVAILABLE
You have to explore 8 different locations in each of which you have to look for objects. You can explore the forest, cave, abandoned city and other locations.

FEATURES
Quite simple and addictive gameplay, just walk and scan

Each level has its own color palette, some objects have different colors

8 levels available for exploration

Customization of patterns for the scanner

ABOUT
The game was inspired by Scanner sombre and the G'mod Lidar addon. The game was originally created as a prototype called "Lidar.exe".
name: LiDAR Exploration Program
short: LiDAR Exploration Program is a relaxing atmospheric game with light horror elements, where you explore in complete darkness using a scanner to reveal the world around you.
